definitions.explanation: Having a quality of lightness in movement, sound, or feeling. Suggests gracefulness, ease, and a pleasant lack of heaviness. More poetic and expressive than the plain adjective {軽|かる}い.

examples.japanese: {軽|かる}やかな⟦{足取|あしど}り→足取り：10625_ashidori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To walk with a light step.

examples.japanese: ⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{軽|かる}やかな⟦{旋律|せんりつ}→旋律：04753_senritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{響|ひび}いた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
examples.english: A light piano melody echoed through the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春風|はるかぜ}→春風：27508_harukaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧、⟦{蝶|ちょう}→蝶：04288_chou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軽|かる}やか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{舞|ま}っていた→舞う：04573_mau⟧。
examples.english: Riding the spring breeze, butterflies danced lightly.

notes:
{軽|かる}やか is a na-adjective derived from ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧ (light) with the suffix ～や⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧, which adds a sense of elegance and aesthetic quality. It is more literary and evocative than ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧.

The ～や⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ suffix creates na-adjectives that express a graceful or pleasing quality: ⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧ (calm), ⟦{華|はな}やか→華やか：06070_hanayaka⟧ (gorgeous), ⟦{爽|さわ}やか→爽やか：05701_sawayaka⟧ (refreshing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軽|かる}やかな⟦{足取|あしど}り→足取り：10625_ashidori⟧ (light footsteps)
- {軽|かる}やかな⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧ (light, airy music)
- {軽|かる}やか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{踊|おど}る→踊る：01250_odoru⟧ (to dance lightly)
- {軽|かる}やかな{気持|きも}ち (a light, buoyant feeling)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧: light (plain adjective, broader usage including weight)
- ⟦{身軽|みがる}→身軽：15136_migaru⟧: light on one's feet, unencumbered (focuses on physical freedom)
- ⟦しなやか→しなやか：10353_shinayaka⟧: supple, flexible (emphasizes flexibility rather than lightness)
